structure: Part 12, ins address book: the list, its tabs, filters and roles. Read in full: the 10 read-side specs under tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book (address-book-list.spec.ts 310 lines/16 test declarations expanding to 19 tests through three two-case loops; address-book-role-filter.spec.ts 275 lines/12 declarations in three describes, two of them API-only and one JavaScript-off; address-book-roles.spec.ts 158 lines/11 declarations, all API-only, the last a loop over the three role groups; address-book-tabs.spec.ts 138 lines/7 declarations in three describes; address-book-transporter-type-filter.spec.ts 49 lines/2; address-book-country-list.spec.ts 34 lines/2 declarations, one looping the three role-backed add forms; address-book-auth.spec.ts 22 lines/2; address-book-persistence.spec.ts 33 lines/1; address-book-cross-user-visibility.spec.ts 35 lines/1; address-book-seed.spec.ts 21 lines/1). The counts in the partition's covers are grep counts of every `test`-prefixed token (describes, test.use and beforeEach included), which is why they run ahead of the test counts; every literal declaration in all ten files is accounted for here. Also read in full the three local helpers (expect-address-book-list.ts, expect-other-organisation-address-returns-to-list.ts, run-addresses.ts) and the support files the specs rest on: page-objects/ins/address-book/{list-page,record-page,transporter-view-page,url-with-return}.ts, page-objects/ins/index.ts, page-objects/shared/{base-page,summary-list,opens-at-expected-url}.ts, domain/ins/constants/{address-book-types,address-book-journey,transporter-types,trader-address,trader-transporter,address-details}.ts, domain/shared/constants/{address-types,test-record-names}.ts, domain/ins/models/db/address-document.ts, flows/ins/journey.ts, flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts, fixtures/{ui,auth-state}.ts, utils/{address-book-cleanup,roles-options-assertions}.ts, config/users.ts and bin/reset-e2e-address-book.ts. Read as further context, outside the part's read list: adapters/http/address-book-api-client.ts and adapters/http/organisation.ts (for the list, role and searchRole query shape and the organisation header), tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book/expected-api-refusal.ts (the refusal the roles spec asserts), resources/reference-data/reference-data.ts (addressFormCountryNames) and domain/shared/constants/journey-party-names.ts (the seeded fixture names). Covered: the list page at /address-book with its heading, intro, Add button, hidden-until-opened filter, results line, column headings, row rendering and View action, its empty state and Clear search, its success banners, and its JavaScript-off behaviour; pagination as a rule (page size 8, truncation over five pages, the parameters the next page keeps, when no pagination shows); the four tabs, their order, labels, panel headings, URLs, default and unknown-tab fallback, and which roles each lists; the role filter and the transporter Type filter with every option, the empty-valued placeholder, server-side application on submit and what filtering narrows to; the six roles with the grouping rules the API enforces and its refusals; the country list the add and edit forms offer and where it comes from; the 14 seeded fixture records and the reconcile that keeps them; organisation scoping, cross-user visibility and the signed-out redirect; and the Mongo persistence round-trip. Following the partition's rule that a claim comes from a test, support-file facts no test in this slice asserts are left to the parts whose specs drive them (the add, edit, view and delete pages in part 13, the transporter pages in part 14), with one exception recorded as a ruling. Claims that come from support, handler or tooling code rather than a test assertion start their note with `mechanism:`.
